title: LLM-Guided Cyber-Physical Attack Path Identification in Smart Grids
abstract: arXiv:2611.24765v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Identifying high-impact attack paths in cyber-physical power systems is critical for improving grid resilience. Existing methods typically rely on either structural topology analysis or simulation-based cascading-failure models. Topology-based approaches capture connectivity but lack adversarial reasoning, while simulation-driven methods are primarily suited for offline analysis and are less effective for rapid evaluation of evolving attack scenarios. As a result, identifying realistic attack paths that jointly capture topology, threat semantics, and physical impact remains challenging. This paper presents a physics-grounded framework for identifying cyber-physical attack paths using large language models (LLMs), with cascading-failure-derived impact rankings used as physics-grounded references. translated_title: 基于大语言模型引导的智能电网信息物理攻击路径识别
translated_abstract: 在信息物理电力系统中识别高影响的攻击路径对于提升电网韧性至关重要。现有方法通常依赖于结构拓扑分析或基于仿真的级联故障模型。基于拓扑的方法能够捕捉网络连通性，但缺乏对抗性推理能力；而仿真驱动的方法主要适用于离线分析，对于快速评估不断演变的攻击场景效果欠佳。因此，识别能够同时兼顾拓扑结构、威胁语义和物理影响的现实攻击路径仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。本文提出了一种基于物理特性的框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）来识别信息物理攻击路径，并以级联故障推导的影响排序作为物理层面的参考依据。该框架集成了系统拓扑、LLM引导的STRIDE和MITRE ATT&CK威胁建模，以及用于对比的三种基线策略。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的物理感知框架，融合系统拓扑、STRIDE与MITRE ATT&CK威胁建模以及级联故障影响排序，用于识别智能电网中同时考虑拓扑结构、威胁语义和物理影响的高危害信息物理攻击路径。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physics-grounded, LLM-guided framework that integrates system topology, STRIDE and MITRE ATT&CK threat modeling, and cascading-failure-derived impact rankings to identify high-impact cyber-physical attack paths in smart grids.
